top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards the clearest simple, general mechanism on the slate: the Z2 classification of time-reversal-invariant insulators with protected edge states, which is a new organising principle beyond symmetry breaking, together with the first transport observation of the quantum spin Hall state in HgTe. The Kane, Mele and Molenkamp trio now has identical support from three members, the interpretation has been stable for about fifteen years, and the citation can be bounded to the Z2 insulator and the HgTe observation. The omission of Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan is a real, stated cost but a bounded one. P002 is a mature, cleanly attributed fallback, but it is a sharper measurement within an already recognised paradigm. P003 rests on a settled diffuse flux, but the Halzen-Karle credit is unresolved. A no-award outcome ranks last because every proposal is a defensible award.
